to_binary_string: convert a text string to binary bytes using the default system encoding
to_native_string: convert a binary or text string to the native string format using the default encoding
get_mjlib: get the mujoco library module for use in MuJoCo physics simulation tasks
ndptr: create a numpy ctypes ndpointer type that allows passing None as a NULL pointer
ENV_MJLIB_PATH: review the MJLIB_PATH environment variable constant used to override the MuJoCo shared library path
